component.name: Files
component.summary: Browse and organise files and folders

description.p: Files is the Bingux desktop's file manager. It lists folders, drives and the Trash, and opens files in the application the system chooses for them.

ul.li: Tabs that each keep their own folder, history and scroll position
List and grid views, thumbnails, previews and search inside a folder
Copy, move, rename, trash and undo, with drag and drop between folders and tabs
Drives and removable media with free space

description.p: The window is the same code as the file chooser dialog that other Bingux applications use.
